classification.difficultyReason: Reflect each vertex across the supplied vertical axis by counting equal horizontal grid distances, then join the images.

content.prompt: Reflect triangle $ABC$ in the axis of reflection.

spec.description: Six-by-six drawable grid, unfilled original triangle and vertical double-headed reflection axis. Labelled vertices and axis require native TikZ rather than the blank-grid template.
spec.mathematics: Using an unprinted bottom-left reference frame, A=(1,1), B=(2,4), C=(2,1), with reflection axis x=3.
spec.answerVisibility: Original triangle and reflection axis only; image vertices are withheld.

answer.short: The image triangle is shown, with each image vertex the same perpendicular distance from the axis as its original vertex.
answer.worked: Place $A'$ 2 squares to the right of the axis, level with $A$. Place $B'$ and $C'$ 1 square to the right of the axis, level with $B$ and $C$ respectively. Join $A'$, $B'$ and $C'$.

spec.sourceRegion: Review exercise question 5; teacher PDF page 57, upper-right answer labelled 5
spec.description: Complete original grid and reflection axis with the labelled reflected image added in red.
spec.mathematics: Reflection in x=3 sends (x,y) to (6-x,y), giving A'=(5,1), B'=(4,4), C'=(4,1) in the unprinted reference frame.
